790460101.text: All actors and actresses have arrived, and all stage mechanisms are operating normally.

790460102.text: This performance of "Petrifying Gaze," a play from "Daiya's Three-Day Reverie," will now begin!

790460103.text: On the edge of a thick and eerie forest, two wise and learned sages happen upon a Hydro Eidolon, wandering alone...

790460104.text: Please, help me... someone help me! I don't want to abandon my friends...

790460105.text: Water Droplet!? Wait, did the Water Droplet talk?

790460108.text: Oh, so this Water Droplet is actually a main character in this play, and we have to act along with it?

790460109.text: It is truly fortunate that these two wise sages have already researched the language of Hydro Eidolons in depth, and can understand its plea for help.

790460110.text: This must be a fated encounter! Such a portentous meeting, could you even entertain the notion of not assisting this Hydro Eidolon?

790460111.text: Wow! We have our own characters too? That's really cool.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ride the Choo-Choo Cart to the ancient castle
Ride the Choo-Choo Cart to the ancient castle
Use the Streaming Projector to get the key
Find a way to deal with the ghostly plan

790461001.text: Ugh! It's impossible to avoid their line of sight! This is just cheating!

790461002.text: Paimon just wants to kick those ghost mechanisms right over!

790461003.text: Hey, wait, Water Droplet! What are you doing! There's ghosts there, it's dangerous!

790461004.text: Insolent beings, have you gone insane? Or have you abandoned all hope, and simply wish to see your friends in the next world?

790461005.text: Oh no! It used its body to block their gaze... why does it have such a noble spirit of self-sacrifice!?

790461006.text: A sudden twist! The lonely Hydro Eidolon has thrown itself in front the ghost's vision, using its body to block the fatal gaze, and is slowly turning to stone!

790461007.text: The Water Droplet turned to stone... just so we could get the key...

790461010.text: Oh, right! That's right! As long as we aren't in their line of sight too long, we should be okay!

790461011.text: Did the Water Droplet figure that out? It's so smart and brave!

790461012.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's find the key and get the remedy, fast! We can't let the Water Droplet suffer too long!

subQuests.subQuestName: Use the Streaming Projector to get the key

790461101.text: The speaker continues to describe the strange scene in front of you—\nThe two wise sages slowly drop the remedy onto the petrified body of the Hydro Eidolon, and a strange phenomenon begins to occur...\nAs though time were flowing backward, the petrified Hydro Eidolon begins to return to normal...

790461102.text: *sob* ...So that is how it feels to be turned to stone... The pain, the agony! I cannot let my friends suffer this fate any longer.

790461103.text: Water Droplet, how could you just charge ahead like that without saying anything!? You scared Paimon half to death! It's a good thing we got the remedy so quickly...

790461104.text: That ghost was so scary, I was so terrified I couldn't even speak...

790461105.text: Also, you are so wise that I think you don't even need me to remind you.

790461106.text: Even if I turned completely into a stone, I knew you guys would save me right after you got the remedy, and things would be just like before! So there was no real need to worry.

790461107.text: Huh... uh, did Paimon get too invested in the play? Paimon was just so worried about the Water Droplet...

790461110.text: Eh... Paimon is a guest who's here to have fun, but she let the acting get to her head... It's a little embarrassing...

790461111.text: But anyway, we succeeded! Now you can take the remedy and save your friends!

790461112.text: Thank you, thank you! I... I'm forever indebted to you for all that you've done!

790461113.text: My companions and I will always remember your kindness in our hearts!

subQuests.subQuestName: Open the secret chamber and get the remedy
Open the secret chamber and get the remedy

790460901.text: Though, if a Water Droplet has turned to stone, can it still drink a potion? And how does water even drink water...

790460902.text: Oh! Maybe this remedy is the kind you rub on! Let's try it out!

790461201.text: Complete the challenge, and then you can find the key to the secret chamber... it's all in your hands now!

790461301.text: The two sages watch the poor Hydro Eidolon slowly turn into unfeeling stone before their very eyes, and it no longer responds to their anguished calls...

790461302.text: But this was not in vain! For it was only so willing to sacrifice itself, because it believed in the two sages from the bottom of its heart!
